justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Manual therapy for MSK conditions has consistent short-term benefit; durability and superiority over other PT approaches less clear.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Orthopaedic Manual PT programs require significant coursework (60+ hours); moderate total cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to the majority of outpatient orthopedic and musculoskeletal caseloads; broadly useful in general PT.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Billed under manual therapy CPT 97140; Medicare and commercial coverage standard; no COMT-specific billing premium over general manual therapy.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Consistently sought in outpatient orthopedic PT postings; manual therapy proficiency widely valued.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Hands-on care is highly valued; patients often prefer manual therapy.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Manual therapy is a flagship cash-pay offering; patients regularly pay out of pocket for hands-on care.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: COMT supports premium hourly rates and is widely marketed to consumers seeking 'expert' manual care.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Common enough among orthopedic PTs that it differentiates less than it used to; FAAOMPT is the higher-tier signal.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Manual therapy practices tend to be personality-driven; hard to scale because patients book the clinician, not the brand.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers recognize 'manual therapy' broadly even if not the COMT acronym specifically.
justifications.business.efficiency: Substantial time and cost (often 150-300 hours plus exams), moderate efficiency.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Respected, especially when paired with OCS or FAAOMPT; stronger than commercial brand certs but below board specialties.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Manual therapy has a robust research literature; faculty with this credential publish actively.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Highly relevant for orthopedic and musculoskeletal coursework; core curricular content.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Solid evidence base with many RCTs and systematic reviews, though effect sizes are often modest.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Commonly listed as preferred for ortho faculty roles, particularly when paired with OCS.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Moderate time investment; less efficient than OCS alone but stackable with it.
